title_cyrillic.description: Book title in Cyrillic; null if not determined.

authors_cyrillic.description: List of author names in Cyrillic; empty array if unknown.

illustrators_cyrillic.description: List of illustrator names in Cyrillic; empty array if none or unknown.

publisher_cyrillic.description: Publisher name in Cyrillic; null if unknown.

series_cyrillic.description: Series name in Cyrillic; null if not part of a series or unknown.

format.description: Physical/digital format and number of pages, e.g., 'hardcover, 32 pages', 'paperback, 96 pages', 'audiobook'; null if unknown.

publication_year.description: Publication year of this edition; null if unknown.

isbn.description: List of ISBNs (prefer ISBN-13; include ISBN-10 if available); empty array if unknown.

age_rating.description: Age rating as stated by publisher/retailer, in original language; null if not stated.

genre.description: Genre or category, e.g., 'children's picture book / fairy tale'; null if unknown.

listing_links.description: Up to 10 URLs of pages that list this edition, prioritized: publisher site, author site, Ozon, Labirint, then other reputable sources.

review_links.description: Up to 10 URLs of pages with user reviews/ratings for this title/edition; may overlap with listing_links.
